baseline65.port_identification: Derived unique guest SYN within250ms of report UTC end minus monotonic duration; old recorder lacked socket address metadata

interpretation: No guest FIN/RST before client cleanup during the65-second baseline. In a separate run with no other scripted guest connections,35 seconds of bounded silence preceded a new control SYN and then a reset of the failed session. This is a scheduling-dependent observation, not an unconditional30-second close guarantee or proof of its unique cause. The earlier overlapping network-tick trial is retained separately and is not used as an isolated timing experiment.
